q = 29
# Quadratic residues mod 29
residues = set()
for x in range(1, q):
    residues.add((x*x) % q)
print("Quadratic residues mod 29:", sorted(residues))
print("Number of residues:", len(residues))

# Build the 2-coloring for K_22 from Paley(29)
q = 29
residues = set()
for x in range(1, q):
    residues.add((x*x) % q)

# Take vertices 0..21
n = 22
edges = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        diff = (i - j) % q
        if diff in residues:
            edges.append(0)  # red
        else:
            edges.append(1)  # blue

print("Number of edges:", len(edges))
print("First 20 edges:", edges[:20])
print("Sum (number of blue edges):", sum(edges))
